comments.author: Martin
comments.text:
: Hi Ahmad, I'm not sure in your country, but here in the US each National Park has a visitor center that has a small museum about the park's history, flora and fauna, and the most distinctive geological features.

So perhaps you can talk about such museums in your speech.

Hope this helps.

Regards,

Martin
